description: Describes a supported chain: CAIP-2 id, display name, native currency, block explorers, and exactly which operations it supports. Omit `chain` to list every supported chain.

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain id such as eip155:8453 (Base) or aptos:1; a bare EVM chain id number also works. Chain names like "base" are refused.
